name: smwmusic-ys-iii-wanderers-from-ys-valestein-castle
title: Ys III: Wanderers from Ys - Valestein Castle
description:
The stage theme from Ys III that plays in Valestein Castle (known as Valestine in the English localization of the Mega Drive and the TurboGrafx-CD version, and Ballacetine in the SNES version). Based on the Mega Drive version.

(Note: The track name is taken from the official Ys: The Oath in Felghana album.)
